entries.title: Proverbs 7:1
segments: My son, keep my words and store up my commandments within you.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:2
segments: Keep my commandments and live; and keep my law as the pupil of your eye.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:3
segments: Bind them upon your fingers; write them upon the tablet of your heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:4
segments: Say to wisdom, You [are] my sister; and call understanding [your] kinsman,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:5
segments: so that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the stranger [who] flatters with her words.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:6
segments: For at the window of my house I looked through my lattice,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:7
segments: and I saw among the simple ones, among the youths, a young man with no understanding,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:8
segments: passing through the street near her corner. And he went the way to her house,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:9
segments: in the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:10
segments: And, behold, there a woman met him, [with] the dress of a harlot and a guarded heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:11
segments: She [is] loud and stubborn; her feet do not stay in her house;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:12
segments: now [she is] outside, now in the streets, and lies in wait at every corner.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:13
segments: And she caught him and kissed him, [and] with a hard face she said to him,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:14
segments: [I have] peace offerings with me; today I have paid my vows.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:15
segments: so I came out to meet you, earnestly to seek your face, and I have found you.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:16
segments: I have decked my bed with coverings, with striped cloths of Egyptian linen.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:17
segments: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:18
segments: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning; let us delight ourselves with caresses.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:19
segments: For my husband [is] not at home, he has gone on a long journey;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:20
segments: he has taken a bag of silver with him [and] will come home at the day of the full moon.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:21
segments: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:22
segments: He goes after her immediately, like an ox goes to the slaughter, or like a fool to the correction of the stocks;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:23
segments: until a dart strikes through his liver; as a bird hastens to the snare and does not know that it [is] for his soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:24
segments: And now listen to me, sons, and attend to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:25
segments: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways, do not go astray in her paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:26
segments: For she has cast down many wounded; yea, many strong [men] have been slain by her.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:27
segments: Her house [is] the way to hell, going down to the rooms of death.
